# WC25 · Patient 360 · CSKH · Dịch vụ & tài chính

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · state · Next.js: **none** · account `care-maianh`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/staff-context.js#apply`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#financial`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `crm-ui.js › financial()` plus the `care-finance.js` panels for role care: no "Mở thu ngân →", "＋ Thêm dịch vụ" or "＋ Tạo đơn nháp" (billing and clinical controls removed).
- Inventory note: Invoices and linked panels without "Mở thu ngân →", "＋ Thêm dịch vụ" and "＋ Tạo đơn nháp".
- Page key `patient` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `care-maianh`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role care: consult, session, photos.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role accountant: consult, session, photos, crm.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"tr[data-patient=\"P001\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"} → {"click":"[data-tab=\"finance\"]"}; it must show "Hồ sơ P001".

Kit components used: Card×6, Badge×4, Button×1, Tabs×1, TableShell×1, EmptyState×1; shared pieces: Notice×2. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "Tiền cọc còn chưa phân bổ: 0 ₫. Cọc đã phân bổ được thể hiện riêng trong liệu trình bên dưới."
- (old web notice) "Chăm sóc và phục hồi sau buổi điều trị"
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.
- "Tiền cọc còn chưa phân bổ: 0 ₫. Cọc đã phân bổ được thể hiện riêng trong liệu trình bên dưới."

## Gotchas
- Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.
